title: EnvironmentPermission
description:
Provides details about the relationship between the execution
environment and the user or group that has access to it.

id.description: The internal identifier for this permission entry.

guid.description: The identifier for this permission entry.

environment_guid.description: The identifier of the execution environment.

user_guid.description:
The identifier of the user listed in the permission entry.
This field will be null if a group is listed.

group_guid.description:
The identifier of the group listed in the permission entry.
This field will be null if a user is listed.
